Canonical vehicle release recovery

The release workflow stages the exact validated `vehicle-release.json` on the temporary `release-staging` branch before deployment preflight. The staged commit is a normal commit on top of that exact main/`GITHUB_SHA` tree with `vehicle-release.json` added or replaced -- not an orphan or minimal-payload tree -- so it still carries the real application repo, including `vercel.json`. Vercel's own `git.deploymentEnabled` config (`main` only, every other branch `false`) is what then makes Vercel skip a deployment of this branch, rather than the branch being unbuildable. The staged payload contains no credentials. It exists so an authorized database-management connection can verify and activate the exact CI-built release when the Actions deployment credential is unavailable; after recovery, the branch should be reset away from the staged payload.
